数据组件

远端自动补全 AsamRemoteAutocomplete

在自动补全上管理异步选项、重载和请求取消。

远端自动补全 ​

在自动补全上管理异步选项、重载和请求取消。

基础用法 ​

示例通过本地 Promise 函数加载选项，支持模型更新、暂停与重载。所有请求都留在演示内部。

本地数据与生命周期

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload"
			>强制重载</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()"
			>取消请求</AsamButton
		>
		<p role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ value }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose, AsamApiRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteBasicDemoExample' });
interface Item {
	label: string;
	value: string;
	children?: readonly Item[];
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | number>('');
const active = ref(true);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Item>>();
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const items: readonly Item[] = [
	{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
	{ label: '进行', value: 'running' }
];
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Item[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.includes(params.text));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
</script>
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload"
			>强制重载</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()"
			>取消请求</AsamButton
		>
		<p role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ value }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteBasicDemoExample' });
const value = ref('');
const active = ref(true);
const control = ref();
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const items = [
	{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
	{ label: '进行', value: 'running' }
];
const api = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.includes(params.text));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
function source(text) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
</script>

浮层、完整建议项与错误恢复 ​

popperOptions 和 showArrow 直接作用于实际建议浮层。下面的完整示例关闭箭头、设置偏移，使用 header/footer/loading 和默认建议插槽。选择建议会更新输入模型为其 label，select 返回规范化选项及原始 raw 成员；选项 value 与输入文本不必相同。勾选“模拟接口失败”后强制重载可观察陈旧状态，取消失败选项后再次重载恢复。

浮层、完整建议项与错误恢复

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="autocomplete-demo">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@click="showQueryContract = !showQueryContract"
			>
				展示建议查询协议
			</AsamButton>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">模拟接口失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()"
				>取消请求</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="inspect"
				>读取公开实例</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="showArrow = true"
				>显示浮层箭头</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="showArrow = false"
				>隐藏浮层箭头</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="showArrow = undefined"
				>恢复默认箭头</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="offset = 0"
				>取消额外偏移</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="offset = 16"
				>恢复额外偏移</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			:show-arrow="showArrow"
			:popper-options="popperOptions"
			:debounce="100"
			:loop-navigation="false"
			clearable
			size="default"
			aria-label="搜索成员"
			placeholder="输入 Alpha 或 Beta"
			@update:model-value="recordValue('update:modelValue', $event)"
			@input="recordValue('input', $event)"
			@change="recordValue('change', $event)"
			@select="recordSelect"
			@clear="events.push({ name: 'clear', payload: null })"
			@focus="recordDom('focus', $event)"
			@blur="recordDom('blur', $event)"
			@mouseenter="recordDom('mouseenter', $event)"
			@mouseleave="recordDom('mouseleave', $event)"
			@compositionstart="recordDom('compositionstart', $event)"
			@compositionupdate="recordDom('compositionupdate', $event)"
			@compositionend="recordDom('compositionend', $event)"
			@keydown="recordKey"
			@error="recordError"
			@success="recordSuccess"
		>
			<template #prefix><span data-testid="autocomplete-prefix">找</span></template>
			<template #suffix><span data-testid="autocomplete-suffix">本地</span></template>
			<template #prepend><span data-testid="autocomplete-prepend">成员</span></template>
			<template #append>
				<AsamCollapse
					@mousedown="keepHeaderFocus"
					class="instance-controls"
					data-testid="autocomplete-append"
					><AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
						<template #title><span @mousedown.prevent>实例控制</span></template>
						<div class="actions">
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="inspect"
							>
								读取实例状态
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.focus()"
							>
								实例聚焦
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.blur()"
							>
								实例失焦
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.close()"
							>
								实例关闭建议
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="loadAll"
							>
								实例读取全部建议
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.highlight(0)"
							>
								实例高亮首项
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.highlight(-1)"
							>
								实例取消高亮
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="selectFirst"
							>
								实例选择首项
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="enter"
							>
								实例提交 Enter
							</AsamButton>
						</div>
					</AsamCollapseItem></AsamCollapse
				>
			</template>
			<template #header>
				<p class="panel-caption" data-testid="autocomplete-header">本地异步成员建议</p>
			</template>
			<template #footer>
				<p class="panel-caption" data-testid="autocomplete-footer">
					匹配建议保留 raw；未匹配 Enter 只有 value
				</p>
			</template>
			<template #loading>
				<p class="panel-caption" data-testid="autocomplete-loading">正在加载成员…</p>
			</template>
			<template #default="{ item }">
				<span data-testid="autocomplete-option">{{ item.label }} · {{ item.raw.id }}</span>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		<p role="status">{{ result }} {{ message }}</p>
		<p>模型：{{ value }}；最近按键：{{ lastKey }}；请求次数：{{ requests }}</p>
		<pre>{{ JSON.stringify({ selected, instance, methodResult, events }, null, 2) }}</pre>
		<QueryContract v-if="showQueryContract" />
		<AsamButton
			type="primary"

			@click="showSelectContract = !showSelectContract"

const methodResult = ref('');
const guardErrors = ref<{ limit: string; message: string }[]>([]);
const pending = new Set<() => void>();
function release(): void {
	for (const done of pending) done();
	pending.clear();
	pendingCount.value = 0;
}
const api: AsamApiRequest<{ text: string }, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	calls.value.push(query.text);
	if (hold.value) {
		await new Promise<void>((done) => {
			pending.add(done);
			pendingCount.value = pending.size;
		});
	}
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();

	methodResult: methodResult.value,

	code: number;
	caption: string;
	value: string;
}
type Mode = 'static' | 'array' | 'sync' | 'callback' | 'promise' | 'remote' | 'empty';
type Selection = Native | AsamOption<string, Member> | { value: string | number };
const member: Member = { id: 7, name: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' };
const option: AsamOption<string, Member> = { label: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha', raw: member };
const native: Native = { code: 7, caption: 'Alpha', value: 'alpha' };
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const remoteSource = (query: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api: async () => [member],
		params: { query },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }

const mounted = ref(false);
const busy = ref(false);
const model = ref<string | number>('');
const policy = ref<boolean>();

});

async function mount(next: Mode, value: string | number = '') {

	await nextTick();

						item.label === 'Alpha' &&

			value: item?.value,

			observations.value.push({
				phase: 'instance-unmatched',
				model: value,
				policy: nextPolicy ?? 'undefined',

</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamApiRequest, AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Member {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
type Props = AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>;
type Configuration = Pick<
	Props,
	| 'id'
	| 'ariaLabel'
	| 'tabindex'
	| 'form'
	| 'name'
	| 'autocomplete'
	| 'inputmode'
	| 'placeholder'
	| 'minlength'
	| 'maxlength'
	| 'min'
	| 'max'
	| 'step'
	| 'autofocus'
	| 'rows'
	| 'resize'
>;
const configurations = {
	explicit: {
		id: 'data009-native-input',
		ariaLabel: '原生输入契约',
		tabindex: 3,
		form: 'data009-input-owner',
		name: 'native-query',
		autocomplete: 'on',
		inputmode: 'search',
		placeholder: 'Input contract',
		minlength: 2,
		maxlength: 8,
		min: 2,
		max: 10,
		step: 2,
		autofocus: true,
		rows: 4,
		resize: 'none'
	},
	omitted: {}
} satisfies Record<string, Configuration>;
const mode = ref<'explicit' | 'omitted'>('explicit');
const type = ref<'text' | 'password' | 'number' | 'textarea'>('text');
const model = ref<string | number>('seed');
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);

const queries = ref<string[]>([]);
const configuration = computed(() => configurations[mode.value]);
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	queries.value.push(query.text);
	return [{ id: 7, label: query.text, value: query.text }];
};
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }

	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	mounted.value = true;
}
async function mountNumber() {
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();

}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps, AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
const scenarios = [
	{ value: 'default', label: '省略配置' },
	...['top', 'top-start', 'top-end', 'bottom', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: value
	})),
	{ value: 'style-object', label: '自定义类与对象样式' },
	{ value: 'style-string', label: '字符串样式' },
	{ value: 'style-array', label: '组合样式' },
	{ value: 'local', label: '就地显示，忽略附加目标' },
	{ value: 'selector', label: '传送到指定选择器' },
	{ value: 'element', label: '传送到实际元素' },
	{ value: 'fit', label: '固定为输入宽度' },
	{ value: 'min', label: '输入宽度作为最小宽度' },
	{ value: 'role', label: '自定义输入角色' }
];
const scenario = ref('default');
const liveRole = ref('searchbox');
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const value = ref('');
const mounted = ref(true);
const generation = ref(0);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const member = {
	id: 7,
	value: 'alpha',
	name: 'Alpha member with a deliberately long suggestion label for popup width comparison'
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const source: AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['source'] = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api: async (_params, context) => {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			return [member];
		},
		params: { text },
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }

	if (
		['top', 'top-start', 'top-end', 'bottom', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end'].includes(
			scenario.value

		return {
			placement: scenario.value as AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['placement']

	if (scenario.value === 'style-object')
		return {
			popperClass: 'data009-popup-custom',
			popperStyle: { backgroundColor: 'rgb(11, 22, 33)', borderWidth: '3px' }
		};
	if (scenario.value === 'style-string')
		return { popperStyle: 'background-color: rgb(22, 33, 44); border-width: 4px;' };
	if (scenario.value === 'style-array')
		return { popperStyle: [{ backgroundColor: 'rgb(33, 44, 55)' }, { borderWidth: '5px' }] };
	if (scenario.value === 'local')
		return { teleported: false, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'selector')
		return { teleported: true, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'element') return { teleported: true, appendTo: host.value };
	if (scenario.value === 'fit') return { fitInputWidth: true };
	if (scenario.value === 'min') return { fitInputWidth: false };
	if (scenario.value === 'role') return { containerRole: liveRole.value };
	return {};
});
async function open() {
	liveRole.value = 'searchbox';
	control.value?.close();
	mounted.value = false;
	await nextTick();
	value.value = '';
	generation.value++;
	mounted.value = true;
	await nextTick();
	control.value?.focus();
	await control.value?.getData('');
}
</script>

<template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamInput,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamApiRequest,
	AsamDataProvider,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose,
	AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps,
	AsamRequestContext,
	AsamReloadResult
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
interface Call {
	kind: string;
	text: string;
	requestId: number;
	aborted: boolean;
	url?: string;
	method?: string;
}
interface Deferred {
	resolve: (items: readonly Member[]) => void;
	reject: (reason: Error) => void;
	call: Call;
}
const kind = ref<'api' | 'request'>('api');
const activeMode = ref('omitted');
const active = computed(() =>
	activeMode.value === 'omitted' ? undefined : activeMode.value === 'true'
);
const draft = ref('Alpha');
const model = ref<string | number>('retained-model');
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const control = shallowRef<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const calls = ref<Call[]>([]);
const results = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const successes = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const errors = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const hold = ref(false);
const failure = ref(false);
const deferred: Deferred[] = [];
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const mounted = ref(false);
const lastAction = ref('unloaded');
let app: App | undefined;

const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const fields = { label: 'name', value: 'value' } as const;
const cache = { ttlMs: 60000 };
function members(text: string): readonly Member[] {
	return [{ id: 7, name: text, value: text.toLowerCase() }];
}
async function load(call: Call, context: AsamRequestContext): Promise<readonly Member[]> {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	calls.value.push(call);
	const recorded = calls.value.at(-1)!;
	context.signal.addEventListener(
		'abort',
		() => {
			recorded.aborted = true;
		},
		{ once: true }
	);
	if (hold.value)
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			deferred.push({ resolve, reject, call: recorded });
			pendingCount.value = deferred.length;
		});
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('source lifecycle API failure');
	return members(call.text);
}
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = (params, context) =>
	load({ kind: 'api', text: params.text, requestId: context.requestId, aborted: false }, context);
const transformApi = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
function isMember(value: unknown): value is Member {
	return (
		typeof value === 'object' &&
		value !== null &&
		'id' in value &&
		typeof value.id === 'number' &&
		'name' in value &&
		typeof value.name === 'string' &&
		'value' in value &&
		typeof value.value === 'string'
	);
}
function transformRequest(response: unknown): readonly Member[] {
	if (!Array.isArray(response) || !response.every(isMember))
		throw new Error('invalid member response');
	return response;
}
const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
	request: async (config, context) => {
		const text = config.params?.text;
		if (typeof text !== 'string')
			throw new Error('query must reach the real request parameters');
		return load(
			{
				kind: 'request',
				text,
				requestId: context.requestId,
				aborted: false,
				url: config.url,
				...(config.method === undefined ? {} : { method: config.method })
			},
			context
		);
	}
};
const source: AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<string, Member>['source'] = (text) =>
	kind.value === 'api'
		? factory.api({ api, params: { text }, transform: transformApi, fieldNames: fields, cache })
		: factory.request({
				request: { url: '/data009/autocomplete-members', params: { text } },
				transform: transformRequest,
				fieldNames: fields,
				cache
			});
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete<string, Member>;
const snapshot = computed(() => ({
	kind: kind.value,
	active: active.value ?? 'omitted',
	mounted: mounted.value,
	detachedSuggestions: !mounted.value ? (savedControl?.suggestions ?? []) : undefined,
	draft: draft.value,
	model: model.value,
	calls: calls.value,
	pending: pendingCount.value,
	loading: control.value?.loading ?? false,
	suggestions: control.value?.suggestions ?? [],
	lastAction: lastAction.value,
	results: results.value,
	successes: successes.value,
	errors: errors.value
}));
async function mountControl() {
	detach();
	await nextTick();
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(TypedRemote, {
				ref: control,
				modelValue: model.value,
				source,
				...(active.value === undefined ? {} : { active: active.value }),
				debounce: 0,
				triggerOnFocus: false,
				ariaLabel: '来源生命周期成员',
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) => {
					model.value = value;
				},
				onSuccess: (items: readonly AsamOption<string, Member>[]) => {
					successes.value.push(items);
				},
				onError: (error: unknown) => {
					errors.value.push(error);
				}
			})
	});
	provideAsamData(app, provider, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-source-lifecycle' });
	app.mount(host.value);
	mounted.value = true;
	lastAction.value = 'mounted';
}
function detach() {
	if (control.value) savedControl = control.value;
	app?.unmount();
	app = undefined;
	control.value = undefined;
	mounted.value = false;

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import type { AsamApiRequest, AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Member {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const host = ref<HTMLDivElement>();
const control = shallowRef<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>>();
const model = ref<string | number>('Seed');
const kind = ref<'text' | 'password' | 'textarea'>('text');
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	updates = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	changes = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	clears = ref(0);
const events = ref<
	{
		name: string;
		type: string;
		constructor: string;
		nativePayloadSame: boolean;
		key?: string;
		data?: string | null;
	}[]
>([]);
const inspection = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({});
const nativeEvents = new WeakSet<Event>();
const names = [
	'focus',
	'blur',
	'keydown',
	'compositionstart',
	'compositionupdate',
	'compositionend',
	'mouseenter',
	'mouseleave'
];
const capture = (event: Event) => nativeEvents.add(event);
function record(name: string, event: Event) {
	events.value.push({
		name,
		type: event.type,
		constructor: event.constructor.name,
		nativePayloadSame: nativeEvents.has(event),
		...(event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? { key: event.key } : {}),
		...(event instanceof CompositionEvent ? { data: event.data } : {})
	});
}
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: 7, name: params.text, value: params.text.toLowerCase() }];
};
const transform = (members: readonly Member[]) => members;
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete<string, Member>;
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	for (const name of names) host.value.addEventListener(name, capture, true);
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(TypedRemote, {
				ref: control,
				source,
				modelValue: model.value,
				type: kind.value,
				ariaLabel: '建议实例输入',
				debounce: 0,
				triggerOnFocus: false,
				teleported: false,
				showPassword: kind.value === 'password',
				rows: 2,
				autosize: { minRows: 2, maxRows: 4 },
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) => {
					model.value = value;
					updates.value.push(value);
				},
				onInput: (value: string | number) => inputs.value.push(value),
				onChange: (value: string | number) => changes.value.push(value),
				onClear: () => clears.value++,
				onFocus: (event: FocusEvent) => record('focus', event),
				onBlur: (event: FocusEvent) => record('blur', event),
				onKeydown: (event: Event | KeyboardEvent) => record('keydown', event),
				onCompositionstart: (event: CompositionEvent) => record('compositionstart', event),
				onCompositionupdate: (event: CompositionEvent) =>
					record('compositionupdate', event),
				onCompositionend: (event: CompositionEvent) => record('compositionend', event),
				onMouseenter: (event: MouseEvent) => record('mouseenter', event),
				onMouseleave: (event: MouseEvent) => record('mouseleave', event)
			})
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-input-instance' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	app?.unmount();
	for (const name of names) host.value?.removeEventListener(name, capture, true);
});
function inspect() {
	const instance = control.value?.inputRef;
	inspection.value = {
		ready: !!instance,
		inputTag: instance?.input?.tagName ?? null,
		textareaTag: instance?.textarea?.tagName ?? null,
		refTag: instance?.ref?.tagName ?? null,
		refMatchesInput: !!instance?.input && instance.ref === instance.input,
		refMatchesTextarea: !!instance?.textarea && instance.ref === instance.textarea,
		isComposing: instance?.isComposing,
		passwordVisible: instance?.passwordVisible,
		textareaStyle: instance?.textareaStyle,
		rootInputMembersAbsent: [
			'input',
			'textarea',
			'ref',
			'select',
			'clear',
			'resizeTextarea',
			'isComposing',
			'passwordVisible',
			'textareaStyle'
		].every((name) => !(name in (control.value ?? {})))
	};
}
async function operate(name: 'focus' | 'blur' | 'select' | 'clear' | 'resizeTextarea') {
	control.value?.inputRef?.[name]();
	await nextTick();
	inspect();
}
async function reset() {
	model.value = 'Seed';
	await nextTick();
	await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
	events.value = [];
	inputs.value = [];
	updates.value = [];
	changes.value = [];
	clears.value = 0;
	inspect();
}
</script>

	clicks = ref(0);
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]),
	updates = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const requests = ref<string[]>([]),
	suggestions = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Member>['suggestions']>([]);
const icon = () =>
	h(
		'svg',
		{
			viewBox: '0 0 16 16',
			'data-official-layout-icon': iconMode.value,
			'aria-hidden': 'true'
		},
		[h('path', { d: 'M2 2h8v8H2zM10 10l4 4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor' })]
	);
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	requests.value.push(params.text);
	return [{ id: 7, name: params.text, value: params.text.toLowerCase() }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		transform,
		params: { text },
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete<string, Member>;
const options = [
	{ label: 'Restaurant', value: '1' },
	{ label: 'Order No.', value: '2' },
	{ label: 'Tel', value: '3' }
];
function selectChild() {
	return h('div', { 'data-testid': 'official-layout-child-select' }, [
		h(
			AsamSelect,
			{
				modelValue: selected.value,
				valueMode: 'native',
				placeholder: '选择',
				style: { width: '115px' },
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: unknown) => {
					if (typeof value === 'string') {
						selected.value = value;
						childChanges.value.push(value);
					}
				}
			},
			() =>
				options.map((option) => h(AsamOption, { label: option.label, value: option.value }))
		)
	]);
}
function buttonChild() {
	return h(AsamButton, { 'aria-label': '官方附加搜索', icon, onClick: () => clicks.value++ });
}
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(AsamConfigProvider, { size: 'default' }, () =>
				h(
					TypedRemote,
					{
						source,
						key: iconMode.value + ':' + mixed.value,
						modelValue: model.value,
						ariaLabel: '官方布局建议输入',
						triggerOnFocus: false,
						debounce: 0,
						...(size.value === 'omitted' ? {} : { size: size.value }),
						...(iconMode.value === 'prefixIcon' ? { prefixIcon: icon } : {}),
						...(iconMode.value === 'suffixIcon' ? { suffixIcon: icon } : {}),
						ref: control,
						'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) => {
							model.value = value;
							updates.value.push(value);
						},
						onInput: (value: string | number) => inputs.value.push(value)
					},
					{
						...(iconMode.value === 'prefixSlot' ? { prefix: icon } : {}),
						...(iconMode.value === 'suffixSlot' ? { suffix: icon } : {}),
						...(mixed.value === 'prependText' ? { prepend: () => 'Http://' } : {}),
						...(mixed.value === 'appendText' ? { append: () => '.com' } : {}),
						...(mixed.value === 'prependSelect'
							? { prepend: selectChild, append: buttonChild }
							: {}),
						...(mixed.value === 'appendSelect'
							? { prepend: buttonChild, append: selectChild }
							: {})
					}
				)
			)
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-official-layout' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
async function query() {
	await control.value?.getData(String(model.value));
	suggestions.value = control.value?.suggestions ?? [];
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.layout-controls {
	display: flex;

	align-items: center;

.layout-host {
	width: 600px;
	max-width: 100%;
	margin-block: var(--asam-space-md);

vue
<template>
	<section data-testid="autocomplete-official-suggestion-contract">
		<p>八个独立控件保留官方基础、模板、远程、加载及页眉页脚分支。</p>
		<div ref="host" class="data009-official-suggestion-host" />
		<pre data-testid="autocomplete-official-suggestion-result">{{
			JSON.stringify({
				models,
				loadingModel,
				queries,
				selections,
				iconClicks,
				footerClears,
				pending
			})
		}}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, h, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamIcon,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import type { AsamApiRequest, AsamOption, AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface LinkItem {
	value: string;
	link: string;
}
type CaseId =
	| 'basic-focus'
	| 'basic-input'
	| 'template'
	| 'remote'
	| 'loading-ring'
	| 'loading-dots'
	| 'header'
	| 'footer';
type Selection = AsamOption<string, LinkItem> | { readonly value: string | number };
const names: readonly CaseId[] = [
	'basic-focus',
	'basic-input',
	'template',
	'remote',
	'loading-ring',
	'loading-dots',
	'header',
	'footer'
];
const links: readonly LinkItem[] = [
	{ value: 'vue', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vue' },
	{ value: 'element', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/element' },
	{ value: 'cooking', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/cooking' },
	{ value: 'mint-ui', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/mint-ui' },
	{ value: 'vuex', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vuex' },
	{ value: 'vue-router', link: 'https://github.com/vuejs/vue-router' },
	{ value: 'babel', link: 'https://github.com/babel/babel' }
];
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const models = ref<Record<CaseId, string | number>>({
	'basic-focus': '',
	'basic-input': '',
	template: '',
	remote: '',
	'loading-ring': '',
	'loading-dots': '',
	header: '',
	footer: ''
});
const loadingModel = ref<string | number>('');
const queries = ref<{ control: CaseId; query: string; results: readonly LinkItem[] }[]>([]);
const selections = ref<{ control: CaseId; item: Selection }[]>([]);
const iconClicks = ref<{ type: string; nativeMouse: boolean }[]>([]);
const footerClears = ref(0);
const pending = ref<CaseId[]>([]);
const footer = shallowRef<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, LinkItem>>();
const releases = new Map<CaseId, () => void>();
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, LinkItem>();
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete<string, LinkItem>;
const isLoadingCase = (name: CaseId) => name === 'loading-ring' || name === 'loading-dots';
const model = (name: CaseId) => (isLoadingCase(name) ? loadingModel.value : models.value[name]);
const setModel = (name: CaseId, value: string | number) => {
	if (isLoadingCase(name)) loadingModel.value = value;
	else models.value[name] = value;
};
const api: AsamApiRequest<{ control: CaseId; query: string }, readonly LinkItem[]> = async (
	params: { control: CaseId; query: string },
	context
) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	const results = links.filter((item) =>
		item.value.toLowerCase().startsWith(params.query.toLowerCase())
	);
	queries.value.push({ ...params, results });
	if (isLoadingCase(params.control)) {
		pending.value.push(params.control);
		try {
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => reject(context.signal.reason);
				context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				releases.set(params.control, () => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				});
			});
		} finally {
			pending.value = pending.value.filter((name) => name !== params.control);
			releases.delete(params.control);
		}
	} else if (
		params.control === 'remote' ||
		params.control === 'header' ||
		params.control === 'footer'
	) {
		await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
	}
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return results;
};
const source = (control: CaseId, query: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { control, query },
		transform: (rows) => rows,
		fieldNames: { label: 'value', value: 'value' }
	});
const cases = names.map((name) => ({ name, source: (query: string) => source(name, query) }));
const circle = () =>
	h('svg', { class: 'circular', viewBox: '0 0 50 50', 'data-testid': 'official-ring-loader' }, [
		h('circle', { class: 'path', cx: 25, cy: 25, r: 20, fill: 'none' })
	]);
const dots = () =>
	h(
		AsamIcon,
		{ class: 'is-loading', 'data-testid': 'official-dots-loader' },
		{
			default: () =>
				h('svg', { class: 'circular', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' }, [
					h(
						'g',
						{
							class: 'path2 loading-path',
							'stroke-width': 0,
							style: { animation: 'none', stroke: 'none' }
						},
						['dot1', 'dot2', 'dot4', 'dot3'].map((name) =>
							h('circle', { r: 3.375, class: name, rx: 0, ry: 0 })
						)
					)
				])
		}
	);
async function clearFooter() {
	models.value.footer = '';
	footerClears.value++;
	await nextTick();
	await footer.value?.getData('');
}
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(
				'div',
				{ class: 'suggestion-grid' },
				cases.map(({ name, source: caseSource }) =>
					h('article', { 'data-testid': 'official-suggestion-' + name }, [
						h('h3', name),
						...(isLoadingCase(name)
							? [
									h(
										AsamButton,
										{
											type: 'primary',
											nativeType: 'button',
											onMousedown: (event: MouseEvent) =>
												event.preventDefault(),
											onClick: () => releases.get(name)?.()
										},
										{ default: () => '完成官方加载 ' + name }
									)
								]
							: []),
						h(
							TypedRemote,
							{
								...(name === 'footer' ? { ref: footer } : {}),
								modelValue: model(name),
								'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: string | number) =>
									setModel(name, value),
								source: caseSource,
								ariaLabel: '官方建议 ' + name,
								placeholder:
									name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input'
										? '请输入内容'
										: '输入查询内容',
								clearable: name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input',
								teleported: false,
								debounce: 0,
								...(name === 'basic-input' ? { triggerOnFocus: false } : {}),
								...(name === 'template'
									? { popperClass: 'data009-official-template-popper' }
									: {}),
								onSelect: (item: Selection) =>
									selections.value.push({ control: name, item })
							},
							{
								...(name === 'template'
									? {
											suffix: () =>
												h(
													AsamIcon,
													{
														class: 'el-input__icon',
														'data-testid': 'official-template-suffix',
														onClick: (event: MouseEvent) =>
															iconClicks.value.push({
																type: event.type,
																nativeMouse:
																	event instanceof MouseEvent
															})
													},
													{
														default: () =>
															h('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 16 16' }, [
																h('path', {
																	d: 'M2 11l8-8 3 3-8 8H2z',
																	fill: 'currentColor'
																})
															])
													}
												),
											default: ({
												item
											}: {
												item: AsamOption<string, LinkItem>;
											}) => [
												h('div', { class: 'value' }, item.value),
												h('span', { class: 'link' }, item.raw.link)
											]
										}
									: {}),
								...(name === 'loading-ring' ? { loading: circle } : {}),
								...(name === 'loading-dots' ? { loading: dots } : {}),
								...(name === 'header'
									? {
											header: () =>
												h(
													'span',
													{ 'data-testid': 'official-header-content' },
													'页眉内容'
												)
										}
									: {}),
								...(name === 'footer'
									? {
											footer: () =>
												h(
													AsamButton,
													{
														type: 'primary',
														link: true,
														size: 'small',
														onClick: clearFooter,
														'data-testid': 'official-footer-clear'
													},
													{ default: () => '清空' }
												)
										}
									: {})
							}
						)
					])
				)
			)
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-official-suggestions' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	for (const release of releases.values()) release();
	app?.unmount();
});
</script>

<style>
.data009-official-suggestion-host {
	margin-block: var(--asam-space-md);
}

[data-testid='autocomplete-official-suggestion-contract'] pre {
	max-height: 24rem;
	overflow: auto;
	white-space: pre-wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.data009-official-suggestion-host .suggestion-grid {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

	display: inline;
	height: 30px;

	animation: data009-official-loading-rotate 2s linear infinite;
}

	stroke-dasharray: 90, 150;

	stroke: var(--el-color-primary);
	stroke-linecap: round;
}

.data009-official-suggestion-host .loading-path .dot1 {

	animation: data009-official-custom-spin-move 1s infinite linear alternate;
	opacity: 0.3;
}

.data009-official-suggestion-host .loading-path .dot2 {
	transform: translate(calc(100% - 3.75px), 3.75px);
	fill: var(--el-color-primary);
	animation: data009-official-custom-spin-move 1s infinite linear alternate;
	opacity: 0.3;
	animation-delay: 0.4s;
}

.data009-official-suggestion-host .loading-path .dot3 {
	transform: translate(3.75px, calc(100% - 3.75px));
	fill: var(--el-color-primary);
	animation: data009-official-custom-spin-move 1s infinite linear alternate;
	opacity: 0.3;
	animation-delay: 1.2s;
}

.data009-official-suggestion-host .loading-path .dot4 {
	transform: translate(calc(100% - 3.75px), calc(100% - 3.75px));
	fill: var(--el-color-primary);
	animation: data009-official-custom-spin-move 1s infinite linear alternate;
	opacity: 0.3;
	animation-delay: 0.8s;
}

@keyframes data009-official-loading-rotate {
	to {
		transform: rotate(360deg);
	}
}

	}

	50% {

	}

	100% {
		stroke-dasharray: 90, 150;
		stroke-dashoffset: -120px;
	}
}

@keyframes data009-official-custom-spin-move {
	to {
		opacity: 1;
	}
}

.data009-official-suggestion-host .data009-official-template-popper li {
	line-height: normal;
	padding: 7px;
}

	overflow: hidden;
}

	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>
vue
<template>
	<section class="autocomplete-demo">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@click="showQueryContract = !showQueryContract"
			>
				展示建议查询协议
			</AsamButton>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">模拟接口失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()"
				>取消请求</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="inspect"
				>读取公开实例</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="showArrow = true"
				>显示浮层箭头</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="showArrow = false"
				>隐藏浮层箭头</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="showArrow = undefined"
				>恢复默认箭头</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="offset = 0"
				>取消额外偏移</AsamButton
			>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="offset = 16"
				>恢复额外偏移</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			:show-arrow="showArrow"
			:popper-options="popperOptions"
			:debounce="100"
			:loop-navigation="false"
			clearable
			size="default"
			aria-label="搜索成员"
			placeholder="输入 Alpha 或 Beta"
			@update:model-value="recordValue('update:modelValue', $event)"
			@input="recordValue('input', $event)"
			@change="recordValue('change', $event)"
			@select="recordSelect"
			@clear="events.push({ name: 'clear', payload: null })"
			@focus="recordDom('focus', $event)"
			@blur="recordDom('blur', $event)"
			@mouseenter="recordDom('mouseenter', $event)"
			@mouseleave="recordDom('mouseleave', $event)"
			@compositionstart="recordDom('compositionstart', $event)"
			@compositionupdate="recordDom('compositionupdate', $event)"
			@compositionend="recordDom('compositionend', $event)"
			@keydown="recordKey"
			@error="recordError"
			@success="recordSuccess"
		>
			<template #prefix><span data-testid="autocomplete-prefix">找</span></template>
			<template #suffix><span data-testid="autocomplete-suffix">本地</span></template>
			<template #prepend><span data-testid="autocomplete-prepend">成员</span></template>
			<template #append>
				<AsamCollapse
					@mousedown="keepHeaderFocus"
					class="instance-controls"
					data-testid="autocomplete-append"
					><AsamCollapseItem name="auxiliary-content">
						<template #title><span @mousedown.prevent>实例控制</span></template>
						<div class="actions">
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="inspect"
							>
								读取实例状态
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.focus()"
							>
								实例聚焦
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.blur()"
							>
								实例失焦
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.close()"
							>
								实例关闭建议
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="loadAll"
							>
								实例读取全部建议
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.highlight(0)"
							>
								实例高亮首项
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="control?.highlight(-1)"
							>
								实例取消高亮
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="selectFirst"
							>
								实例选择首项
							</AsamButton>
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								native-type="button"
								@mousedown.prevent
								@click="enter"
							>
								实例提交 Enter
							</AsamButton>
						</div>
					</AsamCollapseItem></AsamCollapse
				>
			</template>
			<template #header>
				<p class="panel-caption" data-testid="autocomplete-header">本地异步成员建议</p>
			</template>
			<template #footer>
				<p class="panel-caption" data-testid="autocomplete-footer">
					匹配建议保留 raw；未匹配 Enter 只有 value
				</p>
			</template>
			<template #loading>
				<p class="panel-caption" data-testid="autocomplete-loading">正在加载成员…</p>
			</template>
			<template #default="{ item }">
				<span data-testid="autocomplete-option">{{ item.label }} · {{ item.raw.id }}</span>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		<p role="status">{{ result }} {{ message }}</p>
		<p>模型：{{ value }}；最近按键：{{ lastKey }}；请求次数：{{ requests }}</p>
		<pre>{{ JSON.stringify({ selected, instance, methodResult, events }, null, 2) }}</pre>
		<QueryContract v-if="showQueryContract" />
		<AsamButton
			type="primary"
			native-type="button"
			@click="showSelectContract = !showSelectContract"
		>
			展示选择载荷契约
		</AsamButton>

<script setup>

		label: value

	{ value: 'style-object', label: '自定义类与对象样式' },
	{ value: 'style-string', label: '字符串样式' },
	{ value: 'style-array', label: '组合样式' },
	{ value: 'local', label: '就地显示，忽略附加目标' },
	{ value: 'selector', label: '传送到指定选择器' },
	{ value: 'element', label: '传送到实际元素' },
	{ value: 'fit', label: '固定为输入宽度' },
	{ value: 'min', label: '输入宽度作为最小宽度' },
	{ value: 'role', label: '自定义输入角色' }

const scenario = ref('default');
const liveRole = ref('searchbox');
const host = ref();
const value = ref('');
const mounted = ref(true);

	id: 7,
	value: 'alpha',

		return {
			popperClass: 'data009-popup-custom',
			popperStyle: { backgroundColor: 'rgb(11, 22, 33)', borderWidth: '3px' }
		};
	if (scenario.value === 'style-string')
		return { popperStyle: 'background-color: rgb(22, 33, 44); border-width: 4px;' };
	if (scenario.value === 'style-array')
		return { popperStyle: [{ backgroundColor: 'rgb(33, 44, 55)' }, { borderWidth: '5px' }] };

		return { teleported: false, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };
	if (scenario.value === 'selector')
		return { teleported: true, appendTo: '#autocomplete-popup-host' };

	model: model.value,

	pending: pendingCount.value,

		...(modifier.value.includes('number') ? { number: true } : {}),

		<div class="validation-controls">
			<label for="data009-validation-mode">建议验证事件</label>
			<AsamSelect id="data009-validation-mode" v-model="mode">
				<AsamOption :label="'omitted'" :value="'omitted'">omitted</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption :label="'true'" :value="'true'">true</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption :label="'false'" :value="'false'">false</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>

				<AsamOption :label="'omitted'" :value="'omitted'">omitted</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption :label="'lazy'" :value="'lazy'">lazy</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>

		</div>

				model: fields.value,
				mode,
				lazy,

				updates,

				validations,
				validateEvents,

				validationMessage: item?.validateMessage
			})

<script setup>
import {
	computed,
	createApp,
	h,
	nextTick,
	onBeforeUnmount,
	onMounted,
	reactive,
	ref,
	shallowRef
} from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamButton,
	AsamBaseForm,
	AsamFormItem,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions,
	provideAsamData
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const host = ref();
const item = shallowRef();
const fields = reactive({ value: 'Seed' });
const mode = ref('omitted');
const lazy = ref('omitted');
const inputs = ref([]),
	updates = ref([]),
	changes = ref([]),
	validations = ref([]);
const validateEvents = ref([]);
const rule = {
	trigger: ['change', 'blur'],
	validator: (_rule, value, callback) => {
		validations.value.push(String(value));
		callback(String(value).includes('!') ? new Error('建议值禁止感叹号') : undefined);
	}
};
const api = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: 7, name: params.text, value: params.text.toLowerCase() }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
const transform = (items) => items;
const source = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'name', value: 'value' }
	});
const configuration = computed(() => ({
	source,
	modelValue: fields.value,
	triggerOnFocus: false,
	debounce: 0,
	ariaLabel: '建议验证输入',
	...(mode.value === 'omitted' ? {} : { validateEvent: mode.value === 'true' }),
	...(lazy.value === 'omitted' ? {} : { modelModifiers: { lazy: true } })
}));
const TypedRemote = AsamRemoteAutocomplete;
let app;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(
				AsamBaseForm,
				{
					model: fields,
					onValidate: (property, valid, message) =>
						validateEvents.value.push({ property, valid, message })
				},
				() =>
					h(AsamFormItem, { prop: 'value', rules: rule, ref: item }, () =>
						h(TypedRemote, {
							...configuration.value,
							'onUpdate:modelValue': (value) => {
								fields.value = String(value);
								updates.value.push(value);
							},
							onInput: (value) => inputs.value.push(value),
							onChange: (value) => changes.value.push(value)
						})
					)
			)
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-validation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
async function reset() {
	fields.value = 'Seed';
	await nextTick();
	await nextTick();
	// Finish the queued blur validation before starting this measurement window.
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
	await nextTick();
	item.value?.clearValidate();
	validations.value = [];
	validateEvents.value = [];
	inputs.value = [];
	updates.value = [];
	changes.value = [];
}
</script>

	{ value: 'element', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/element' },
	{ value: 'cooking', link: 'https://github.com/ElemeFE/cooking' },

async function clearFooter() {
	models.value.footer = '';
	footerClears.value++;
	await nextTick();
	await footer.value?.getData('');
}
let app;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp({
		render: () =>
			h(
				'div',
				{ class: 'suggestion-grid' },
				cases.map(({ name, source: caseSource }) =>
					h('article', { 'data-testid': 'official-suggestion-' + name }, [
						h('h3', name),
						...(isLoadingCase(name)
							? [
									h(
										AsamButton,
										{
											type: 'primary',
											nativeType: 'button',
											onMousedown: (event) => event.preventDefault(),
											onClick: () => releases.get(name)?.()
										},
										{ default: () => '完成官方加载 ' + name }
									)
								]
							: []),
						h(
							TypedRemote,
							{
								...(name === 'footer' ? { ref: footer } : {}),
								modelValue: model(name),
								'onUpdate:modelValue': (value) => setModel(name, value),
								source: caseSource,
								ariaLabel: '官方建议 ' + name,
								placeholder:
									name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input'
										? '请输入内容'
										: '输入查询内容',
								clearable: name === 'basic-focus' || name === 'basic-input',
								teleported: false,
								debounce: 0,
								...(name === 'basic-input' ? { triggerOnFocus: false } : {}),
								...(name === 'template'
									? { popperClass: 'data009-official-template-popper' }
									: {}),
								onSelect: (item) => selections.value.push({ control: name, item })
							},
							{
								...(name === 'template'
									? {
											suffix: () =>
												h(
													AsamIcon,
													{
														class: 'el-input__icon',
														'data-testid': 'official-template-suffix',
														onClick: (event) =>
															iconClicks.value.push({
																type: event.type,
																nativeMouse:
																	event instanceof MouseEvent
															})
													},
													{
														default: () =>
															h('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 16 16' }, [
																h('path', {
																	d: 'M2 11l8-8 3 3-8 8H2z',
																	fill: 'currentColor'
																})
															])
													}
												),
											default: ({ item }) => [
												h('div', { class: 'value' }, item.value),
												h('span', { class: 'link' }, item.raw.link)
											]
										}
									: {}),
								...(name === 'loading-ring' ? { loading: circle } : {}),
								...(name === 'loading-dots' ? { loading: dots } : {}),
								...(name === 'header'
									? {
											header: () =>
												h(
													'span',
													{ 'data-testid': 'official-header-content' },
													'页眉内容'
												)
										}
									: {}),
								...(name === 'footer'
									? {
											footer: () =>
												h(
													AsamButton,
													{
														type: 'primary',
														link: true,
														size: 'small',
														onClick: clearFooter,
														'data-testid': 'official-footer-clear'
													},
													{ default: () => '清空' }
												)
										}
									: {})
							}
						)
					])
				)
			)
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'data009-autocomplete-official-suggestions' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	for (const release of releases.values()) release();
	app?.unmount();
});
</script>

浮层按钮切换 showArrow 的 false、true 与 undefined；undefined 恢复原生默认箭头。 偏移按钮在同一份 popperOptions 中将 offset 的纵向值在 0 和 16 之间切换， 实际浮层位置随之改变。这些展示配置不改变 source 的查询和选项数据。

同一示例的实例按钮支持聚焦、失焦、关闭建议、读取全部建议、高亮首项或取消高亮、 选择首项以及处理 Enter。getData('') 通过本例 source 请求空查询，返回当前完整建议； handleSelect 使用实际建议对象，模型提交其 label，事件保留 value 与 raw。 高亮首项后调用 handleKeyEnter 提交该项；实时 highlightedIndex、activated、 loading 与建议列表可用“读取实例状态”观察。实例控制放在 append 插槽内，避免外部点击先关闭建议；按钮阻止 mousedown 抢走输入焦点， 让实例操作保持可观察；失焦和关闭仍由各自公开方法执行。

本例显式设置 loopNavigation=false，因此 highlight(-1) 取消当前高亮； 原生默认循环导航启用时，负索引会转至末项。实例控制向上展开，避免覆盖建议列表。

数据来源与覆盖 ​

source(query) 根据当前搜索文本创建 api 或 request 类型的 AsamOptionsSource，必须把 query 放进实际请求参数。它接管静态 options 和基础查询回调；不能同时传静态选项或第二个查询来源。示例通过本地 API 过滤标签，空文本返回完整列表。

来源必须由 defineAsamOptions 的 api 或 request 工厂创建；静态来源不适用。映射、同步 transform 和可选 cache 写在 source 工厂内；组件不另收 api/request/dataSource/dictType。即使是 JavaScript 消费端，同时传 options、fetchSuggestions、remoteSuggestions、valueKey 或第二个数据入口也会作为配置错误拒绝，避免绕过既有来源。

自动补全模型是 string | number，select 事件提供建议项；选项来源接管 fetchSuggestions、remoteSuggestions 与 valueKey。

生命周期、事件与实例 ​

active=false 暂停请求并保留上次成功数据；reload({ force: true }) 请求新数据，cancel() 取消当前请求。success 返回规范化选项数组，error 返回 AsamDataError；旧成功数据更新失败时组件显示过期状态。reload 的 status 为 success、error 或 cancelled；不能把取消当作成功。

自动补全以基础 debounce 控制查询节奏；不额外声明 immediate 或 debounceMs。实例继承基础自动补全能力并增加 reload/cancel。

输入请求保持当前 query；旧请求即使忽略取消后迟到，也不能覆盖新 query 的数据。失败保留上次成功的建议并显示过期提示，首个失败保持空数据。reload 成功后同步更新可见建议，不额外发送第二次请求。cancel 不清空已成功建议，也不把迟到结果当成功；一般 scope/epoch 失效沿用数据 provider 的隔离规则。

公开事件完整保留 update:modelValue、input、change、select、clear、focus、blur、compositionstart/compositionupdate/compositionend、mouseenter/mouseleave 和 keydown，另外增加 success/error。composition 事件保留 CompositionEvent，键盘事件保留原事件；focus/blur 为 FocusEvent。基础只读、禁用、清空、.lazy、输入属性与四档 ASAM 尺寸仍适用。

完整 native-data 示例在同一观察区记录事件名称与实际载荷：模型/input/change 保留输入值， clear 无事件参数，select 保留规范化选项与 raw，success 是成功的选项数组，error 保留 kind/message。DOM 事件记录其具体类型、constructor、isTrusted，以及键盘 key 或 composition data。 滚动观察区显示完整记录，原始事件本身仍由对应监听器接收。

实例 行为
highlightedIndex / activated / loading 当前基础建议索引、激活和加载状态的实时只读视图
inputRef / popperRef 基础 Input 与 Tooltip 实例，挂载前可为 undefined
suggestions 当前实际建议数组，保留具体 AsamOption<V, I> 和 raw 类型
focus / blur / close / highlight(index) 控制焦点、建议显隐与当前高亮
getData(query) 通过本组件 source 拉取指定 query 并更新基础建议，返回 Promise
handleSelect(option) / handleKeyEnter() 选择完整建议项或处理当前 Enter 行为，返回 Promise
reload({ force? }) 返回 success（含数据/fromCache）、error 或 cancelled；force 绕过可选应用本地缓存
cancel() 取消本消费者的当前请求，保留成功快照

插槽与基础能力 ​

default 插槽接收 { item: AsamOption<V, I> }；prefix、suffix、prepend、append、header、footer、loading 七个命名插槽完整沿用基础自动补全。默认建议过滤 disabled 项，并受 maxSuggestions 的正整数限制；没有自定义插槽时显示选项 label。

上面的完整示例同时展示八个插槽：prefix 的“找”、suffix 的“本地”和 prepend 的“成员” 位于真实 Input 对应区域，append 承载实例控制；header/footer 位于建议面板，loading 在实际请求等待时替换列表内容。默认插槽读取具体 item.label 与 item.raw.id，选择行为仍由 原生建议项触发。七个命名插槽没有额外 scope 参数。

本站继承关系 ​

  • 自动补全：适用的基础展示、交互与公开 API。

本页数据来源、模型、事件和实例的覆盖规则优先；本站链接不扩大本组件公开契约。尺寸使用基础组件的 ASAM 尺寸规则，示例使用 default。

模型修饰符与输入状态 ​

v-model.lazy 沿用当前基础自动补全的行为：输入时即更新 modelValue，并将当前 query 发送给 source；按 Tab 失焦后发出 change，模型保持已提交值。选择建议会立即提交其 label。示例将请求记录、模型与 input/change 并排展示，可输入新文本后按 Tab 观察事件时序。只读和禁用阻止编辑；min/max/step 传给实际 input，示例文本输入不会因此执行数字范围校验。所有接口在本地运行。

模型修饰符与输入状态

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<main>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model.lazy="value"
			:source="source"
			:debounce="0"
			:trigger-on-focus="false"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:teleported="false"
			:min="2"
			:max="10"
			:step="2"
			clearable
			aria-label="延迟提交建议"
			@input="inputs.push($event)"
			@change="changes.push($event)"
		>
			<template #default="{ item }">{{ item.label }} · {{ item.raw.id }}</template>
		</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" data-testid="blur-target"
			>移出输入</AsamButton
		>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-model">{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-calls">{{ JSON.stringify(calls) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-events">{{ JSON.stringify({ inputs, changes }) }}</pre>
	</main>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteLazyDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamApiRequest, AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Item {
	id: string;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | number>('seed');
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Item>>();
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const inputs = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const changes = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
const calls = ref<string[]>([]);
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Item[]> = async (query, context) => {
	calls.value.push(query.text);
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: query.text, label: query.text, value: query.text }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (rows) => rows,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
</script>

			ref="control"
			v-model.lazy="value"
			:source="source"
			:debounce="0"
			:trigger-on-focus="false"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:teleported="false"
			:min="2"
			:max="10"
			:step="2"
			clearable
			aria-label="延迟提交建议"
			@input="inputs.push($event)"
			@change="changes.push($event)"
		>
			<template #default="{ item }">{{ item.label }} · {{ item.raw.id }}</template>
		</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="primary" data-testid="blur-target"
			>移出输入</AsamButton
		>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-model">{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-calls">{{ JSON.stringify(calls) }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="lazy-events">{{ JSON.stringify({ inputs, changes }) }}</pre>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteLazyDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteAutocomplete,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref('seed');
const control = ref();
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const inputs = ref([]);
const changes = ref([]);
const calls = ref([]);
const api = async (query, context) => {
	calls.value.push(query.text);
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return [{ id: query.text, label: query.text, value: query.text }];
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
const source = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (rows) => rows,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
</script>

建议查询参数的完整消费者 ​

native-data 的“展示建议查询协议”在原示例中增加独立输入，直接消费同一个公开远端自动补全入口；本地查询返回 Alpha、Beta、禁用的 Disabled 和 Delta，规范化后显示可用建议。原示例的事件、浮层和实例按钮仍然保留。新增实例操作放在真实 append 插槽内，展开后从输入上方操作；外部普通按钮点击会按原生规则关闭建议，不能据此观察高亮导航。

参数 完整示例中的作用
maxSuggestions 限制规范化后的可用建议数量，先去掉 disabled 项再截取；1、2 和 undefined 可切换，undefined 恢复默认 100。0、负数、小数、NaN 和 Infinity 在实际 getData 中被拒绝，示例捕获后恢复默认读取。
triggerOnFocus false 不因聚焦发查询，但输入仍查询；true 与 undefined 保留聚焦时的当前文本查询。
highlightFirstItem true 在建议加载后高亮首项，false 与 undefined 不自动高亮。
loopNavigation true 与 undefined 在已激活建议面板中将负索引绕到末项；false 将 -1 保留为取消高亮。
hideLoading true 隐藏加载内容，false 与 undefined 显示 loading 插槽；该显示设置不改变实例 loading 或本地请求的等待状态。
debounce 省略或 undefined 继承原生默认 300ms，合并快速输入的草稿查询；显式 0 按当前 query 立即查询，180ms 合并快速输入。该参数控制基础自动补全查询，不是另一个数据层 debounceMs。

“持有本地请求”使等待状态保持可观察；“释放本地等待”完成原请求。数量、键盘及加载显示的设置不修改来源返回的实体或原始 raw，也不连接服务器。两种类型示例均使用同一组操作。

inputRef 与 popperRef 是实时只读的可选嵌套实例。示例可“停用协议输入”，保存的公开 expose 在组件卸载后读到空的两个引用，再“恢复协议输入”取得新实例；这不依赖伪造实例形状。调用方先判断引用存在，再使用嵌套能力。

selectWhenUnmatched 的 false 与 undefined 在没有建议时不发送 select。此前正常包 56682 启用 true 后，原生未匹配提交产生的载荷只有 { value: 当前模型 }，没有来源实体的 label/raw；该旧包的声明与载荷不一致，历史失败记录保留。

在消费包含 UI026 未匹配选择修正的兼容正常候选时，select 事件为“完整匹配建议或 { value: string | number }”。selectWhenUnmatched=true 的空建议 Enter 可返回仅有 value 的对象；默认和 false 不产生这次选择。读取 raw 或 label 前先用 'raw' in item 缩窄。匹配选项的原始业务对象、默认插槽 item、suggestions、handleSelect 参数及 success 仍保持完整选项，不能用仅有 value 的对象替代。

此前正常包 56682 的未匹配载荷／声明冲突记录保留；后继候选必须单独完成实际消费与独立复核才能关闭原四条 FAIL，包到位本身不表示通过。

native-data 的“展示选择载荷契约”可独立核对六种匹配来源，以及字符串／数字空建议的默认、false、true 策略和实际键盘 Enter。匹配事件保持 suggestions 中同一完整对象；远程来源的 raw 是数据归一化后复制并冻结的业务快照，与 success 中的 raw 保持同一引用，不会冻结宿主返回的原对象。默认插槽仍可直接读取完整建议，未匹配事件则先判断 raw 是否存在。

原生输入属性与模型 ​

native-data 的“展示原生输入协议”使用独立的本地 API，输入草稿进入真实 source 参数，输入内容不会发送到服务器。可切换完整属性与省略属性，观察模型、输入事件和查询记录。建议浮层翻到输入上方时，先按 Escape 关闭建议，再操作工具栏。

参数 完整示例行为
modelValue 外部写入字符串 seed 或数字 42 时，输入分别显示 seed 或 42；实际编辑后按原生输入行为提交字符串模型，并保留 input、update:modelValue 与 query。
id、ariaLabel、tabindex、form、name 传给真实 input／textarea。显式 form 绑定独立表单；省略后解除该表单关联。省略 id 使用原生生成的 ID，不依赖其具体值；省略 tabindex 为 0。
autocomplete、inputmode、placeholder 完整属性使用 on、search 和 Input contract；省略后 autocomplete 恢复 off，inputmode 属性移除，placeholder 恢复 ASAM 默认“请输入”。
minlength、maxlength 最短 2、最长 8。真实键入一个字符触发原生 tooShort，有效字符输入最多保留八个；省略后解除这两项限制。
readonly、disabled 只读阻止编辑而保留模型；禁用阻止编辑和原生输入交互。解除后恢复可编辑状态，不伪造新模型。
type、rows、resize text、password 保留字符串模型；textarea 使用四行、resize=none，省略后恢复原生两行。“全新挂载数字输入”独立验证 number，不承诺动态切换已经通过。
min、max、step 文本输入仅透传原生属性，不进行数字范围裁剪。全新 number 输入使用 2、10、2：3 触发 stepMismatch、1 触发 rangeUnderflow、12 触发 rangeOverflow、4 有效。
autofocus 显式设置真实 autofocus 属性；符合原生浏览器条件的新文档首次输入会聚焦。省略后重挂载不抢焦点，设置 true 不保证任意已有焦点文档中每次重挂载都聚焦。

固定 Element Plus 2.14.7 存在原生兼容限制：先编辑 text／password，再将同一输入元素动态切到 number，后续编辑会因旧光标快照调用不支持的 setSelectionRange 而触发 InvalidStateError。原生、基础和远端自动补全的实际对照均出现该错误；模型更新与范围、步长状态正确不代表这条动态路径无异常。ASAM 沿用原生输入行为，保留这项兼容限制。示例的“全新挂载数字输入”分支已独立验证 number 的模型与 min／max／step 行为，该结果不覆盖上述动态切换限制；原失败证据保留。

生命周期的“建议浮层协议”展示 placement 六个原生方向、popperClass 与对象／字符串／组合 popperStyle、teleported 就地或传送、appendTo 选择器或实际元素，以及 fitInputWidth 固定输入宽度和最小宽度。每次打开配置都重挂载同一公开 RemoteAutocomplete，并通过真实 source 返回完整成员建议。省略配置用于观察原生默认；containerRole 是输入角色参数，浮层仍有自己的 listbox／region 角色。

固定 2.14.7 原生 Autocomplete 在 onMounted 中把输入 role 设为 textbox；因此初次 containerRole=searchbox 不改变这次挂载后的 textbox。示例另外切换已挂载输入的角色为 group，可观察实际属性更新，而外层 autocomplete 的 combobox 不变。这项生命周期边界保留，不把普通 Input 的角色表现直接套到 Autocomplete。

“来源生命周期”使用同一个公开 RemoteAutocomplete 验证 source(query) 创建 API 或 URL request 描述，实际查询进入参数。请求开关覆盖省略、true 和 false；重载覆盖省略选项、force=false 和 force=true。可持有响应、取消后迟到完成、模拟请求失败并恢复，公开 suggestions 保留完整业务 raw，取消和停用不清除已选择模型。URL 来源通过独立消费应用的 provider.request 承接，示例不改变其他消费者的 provider。

“建议外观协议”展示 large／big／default／small 四档尺寸。省略 size 时继承同一消费应用中的 ConfigProvider，提供者尺寸可实时改变；输入显式尺寸优先。clearable 覆盖省略、true、false，以及空值、只读和禁用时的清除按钮表现。clearIcon、prefixIcon、suffixIcon 可传 Vue 组件或本应用注册的字符串名称；示例在独立消费应用内注册图标，不修改其他应用的注册表。inputStyle 可使用 CSS 对象、CSS 文本或样式数组，恢复省略会清除已有内联覆盖。清除按钮通过真实点击更新模型并触发 clear，建议来源仍返回完整成员 raw。

建议格式协议：原 TS/JS native-data 示例的“展示建议格式协议”入口在独立 provider 应用内演示 formatter、parser 和 modelModifiers。可以切换省略、仅格式化、格式化与解析配对，以及空对象、trim、number、lazy 和组合；对照原生显示、input/change、受控模型与完整来源建议。格式化仅影响显示，配对 parser 将显示值还原到模型和查询；number 的 input/change 保留原生规范化文本，受控模型经 Vue 的模型修饰符转为数值，非数值文本仍保留。含 lazy 的配置同样在 input 时提交模型；lazy-trim-number 的 input/query 保留输入原文，模型经 Vue 修饰符归一化，change 保留原生规范化文本。入口保留原示例和实例，关闭标记通过省略键实现；移除格式化后，在下一次模型值变更时恢复原生显示。

建议文本能力：原 TS/JS native-data 示例的“展示建议文本能力”入口可切换 showWordLimit、wordLimitPosition、countGraphemes、showPassword 与 autosize。独立 provider 应用对照原生字数和 Intl.Segmenter 字素计数、ZWJ 家庭表情与代理对、超限插入恢复、完整来源 raw 建议、只读/禁用计数隐藏、密码实际显隐及模型不变、文本域布尔与 minRows/maxRows 自适应。切换 text/textarea 时由原生输入替换对应 DOM，其余同类交互使用同一元素；高度来自内容和公开配置，不强制覆写。

建议验证协议：原 TS/JS native-data 示例的“展示建议验证协议”入口在独立 provider 应用内组合公开 AsamBaseForm/AsamFormItem，切换 validateEvent 省略/真/假及普通/lazy 提交。对照真实规则调用、表单 validate 事件、错误信息、修复成功和模型/input/change；公开默认值应继承基础验证参与。省略默认值的实际接收行为随当前安装产物记录，不以挂载或声明存在代替验证。

修正后的候选对省略 validateEvent 保留 undefined，使基础组件的默认验证参与生效；显式 false 仍关闭验证。普通与 lazy 配置分别记录 input 后的模型、change/blur 及真实校验结果，两者都不以失焦作为模型首次提交的前提；错误值恢复有效后可观察成功状态。原省略默认未参与验证的失败记录继续保留。

建议输入实例协议：原 TS/JS native-data 示例的“展示建议输入实例协议”入口在独立 provider 应用内读取公开 inputRef。input、textarea、ref、select、clear、resizeTextarea、isComposing、passwordVisible 和 textareaStyle 属于该命名输入实例，不能直接调用 Remote 根上的同名方法。可观察真实聚焦/失焦、键盘 payload、原生鼠标事件对象、组合事件期间暂缓模型提交、结束时单次提交、输入/文本域引用切换、密码状态及按原生值重新测量文本域。组合事件由浏览器 DOM 协议模拟，不声称已验证操作系统输入法。

官方输入组合协议：原 TS/JS native-data 的“展示官方输入组合协议”补齐固定 2.14.7 Input 官方示例中的组合分支：text 和 textarea 的 clearable、自定义 clearIcon、inside/outside 字数计数，以及 UTF-16 与 Intl.Segmenter 字素上限。每个组合保留完整来源 raw 和受控模型；四个字素输入不能额外提交。password-icon 通过独立 AsamPassword 的 visible 布尔插槽组合承接；Remote 根及普通 AsamInput 均未增设该插槽。密码切换保持同一输入和模型。

计数协议另含固定官方原例的 Array.from 代码点回调模式，与 UTF-16 和 Intl.Segmenter 字素模式分别观察。代码点模式使用独立表情，字素模式另外覆盖 ZWJ 家庭表情；两种回调都在 text／textarea 和 inside／outside 中验证，不能把代码点数称为完整字素数。

密码原例的默认图标和自定义图标分别由两个 AsamPassword 承接，共享一个受控模型；两个可见状态保持独立，修改一端时另一端同步值。

固定 2.14.7 的基础输入、禁用、formatter/parser、两行文本域及 autosize 布尔/对象示例分别由已有完整协议承接：基础输入与禁用见原生输入协议，显示/解析与真实来源见建议格式协议，两行默认和四行显式 rows 分别观察，自动高度覆盖 true 与 minRows=2/maxRows=4。这里复用已运行的原 TS/JS 文件和实际 Story 观察，不把官方示例文件存在本身当作行为完成。

source(query) 是唯一建议来源：fetchSuggestions（回调或数组）、valueKey 及其短横线写法在公开类型中排除，JavaScript 初始化传入时会在任何请求之前抛出 config 错误。已淘汰的 label 改用 ariaLabel，popper-append-to-body 改用 teleported 与 appendTo；旧名字不属于支持的公开接口，未知 HTML 属性透传不构成兼容承诺。正常安装包的独立 SSR 初始化协议验证完整拒绝列表，现有浏览器协议继续验证实际 aria-label、弹层目的地和 source(query) 请求；SSR 结果不声称证明客户端更新时的拒绝。

官方输入布局协议保留原 with-icon、mixed-input、various-size 的所有分支：默认尺寸省略与 large/small 各自组合无图标、前图标、后图标；另覆盖 ASAM big 档。前后图标分别通过组件属性和插槽呈现。附加内容分别呈现 Http://、.com，以及前 Select／后搜索按钮和前搜索按钮／后 Select；三项选择使用公开 AsamSelect 与 AsamOption，按钮使用 AsamButton，真实选择及点击不改建议输入模型，最后真实输入 Layout 经 source(query) 获得完整 raw。此处只验证数据组件的插槽组合，不代替 Select 的整卡验收。

布局分支对应官方原例中分别挂载的控件；切换组合时独立挂载配置，受控模型与提供者保留，同一配置内尺寸、选择和按钮操作保持建议输入节点。额外探索中的同实例动态插槽新增／移除曾使原生 Input 后缀可见状态保留旧值，完整失败原件仍保留；这里不承诺该动态切换行为。

官方建议分支协议完整展示基础示例的两个独立模型与默认 focus／仅输入触发、前缀忽略大小写过滤、真实选择及清除；模板示例包含可点击的 suffix 图标、建议值和完整链接；远程搜索使用 ASAM source 承接请求与原始数据。两种自定义加载 SVG 保留官方圆环及四圆点的几何与动画，并共享模型。页眉与页脚分开呈现，页脚 Clear 真实清空模型并调用公开 getData('') 重新读取全部七项，保留原链接。为稳定演示，将官方随机等待改为固定 60ms，加载图标用“完成官方加载”按钮控制完成；teleported=false 与 debounce=0 仅用于该示例的局部观察。回调与 value-key 已迁移至 source 与 fieldNames，不宣称旧接口仍受支持。

Input 属性索引：固定 2.14.7 Autocomplete 的 Input 属性链接展开为 35 个原始属性。除已经共同确认淘汰的 label 改用 ariaLabel 外，其余 34 项由原生输入、建议格式、建议文本、验证、官方输入组合与布局协议逐项承接；name 复用同一公开属性，不另造重复接口。输入类型专属的 rows、autosize、resize、长度与计数条件保持原生边界，min、max、step 透传属性而不替宿主裁剪值。命名输入实例的方法与 password-icon 的独立 AsamPassword 组合见各自协议，不能把索引解释为 Remote 根新增这些接口。

局部请求错误插槽 ​

可选 error 插槽仅在当前请求错误存在时调用，接收只读 { error, stale, retry }。 error 与本实例 error 事件中的 AsamDataError 为同一对象，保留 cause、kind、 message 与 notified；渲染插槽不会再次通知 provider。stale 表示保留的数据已过期。

retry() 不接收参数，直接返回现有 reload({ force: true }) 的 Promise，结果为 AsamReloadResult<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]> 的 success、error 或 cancelled 分支。 重试遵守 active、当前来源、取消和卸载规则，不改写模型。 成功重试还等待原生建议刷新，并复用成功结果，不额外请求。

提供该插槽时，自有内容替换整个默认局部错误区；返回空内容也表示主动替换。 未提供时继续显示原错误文字、过期提示和默认重试按钮。无 error 的单独 stale 状态 不调用此插槽；empty、loading 和其他基础插槽继续使用原作用域。

以下完整 TS/JS 示例先制造失败，再等待插槽 retry 的返回结果；成功后可再次制造 更新失败，观察旧结果与模型保留。每次挂载使用独立子 app 和本地 provider。

局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复

展开源码
vue
<template><div ref="host" /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteDemoLocalErrorExample' });
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createTransport } from './transport.js';
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const transport = createTransport();
	app = createApp(Child, { transport });
	provideAsamData(app, transport.provider, { scope: 'AsamRemoteAutocomplete-local-error' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

<template>
	<section>
		<AsamRemoteAutocomplete
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:trigger-on-focus="false"
		>
			<template #error="{ error, stale, retry }">
				<div role="alert" data-testid="local-error">
					<p>{{ error.message }}（{{ error.kind }}）</p>
					<p v-if="stale">已保留上次成功结果。</p>
					<AsamButton
						type="primary"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="busy"
						@click="recover(retry)"
					>
						恢复并重试
					</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteAutocomplete>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" :disabled="busy" @click="failAgain"
			>模拟更新失败</AsamButton
		>
		<p role="status" data-testid="retry-result">{{ result }}</p>
		<p data-testid="transport-count">
			请求 {{ transport.calls.value }} 次，字典刷新 {{ transport.refreshes.value }} 次
		</p>
		<pre data-testid="local-model">{{ value }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteAutocomplete, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose, AsamRemoteAutocompleteSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref<string>('');
const control = ref<AsamRemoteAutocompleteExpose<string, Item>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>().api({
	api: transport.api,
	params: undefined,
	transform: (rows) => rows,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
});
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamRemoteAutocompleteSlots<string, Item>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>
ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteAutocompleteChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteAutocomplete, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = defineProps({ transport: { type: Object, required: true } });
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref('');
const control = ref();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions().api({ api: transport.api, params: undefined });
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(retry) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>
js
import { ref } from 'vue';
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		];
	};
	const provider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (_type, context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}

API

属性 AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps

由 source(query) 创建唯一 api/request 来源，query 必须进入实际请求参数。 来源接管 options/fetchSuggestions/remoteSuggestions/valueKey；不能再传第二个来源。 popperOptions/showArrow、基础输入 props、事件和插槽保留其公开契约。

import type { Attrs } from 'vue';
import type { AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps, AsamValue, AsamRecord, AsamOptionsSource, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps
type PublicContract<V extends AsamValue = AsamValue, I extends object = AsamRecord> = {
	readonly "source": (query: string) => AsamOptionsSource<V, I, "api" | "request">;
	readonly "active"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "form"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "ariaLabel"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "id"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "popperClass"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["popperClass"];
	readonly "popperStyle"?: import("vue").StyleValue;
	readonly "placement"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["placement"];
	readonly "popperOptions"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["popperOptions"];
	readonly "showArrow"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "appendTo"?: string | HTMLElement | undefined;
	readonly "teleported"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "disabled"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "tabindex"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "size"?: AsamControlSize | undefined;
	readonly "type"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["type"];
	readonly "name"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "max"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "modelValue"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "formatter"?: ((value: string) => string) | undefined;
	readonly "rows"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "resize"?: "horizontal" | "vertical" | "none" | "both" | undefined;
	readonly "min"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "autofocus"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "validateEvent"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "clearable"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "step"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "clearIcon"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["clearIcon"];
	readonly "prefixIcon"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["prefixIcon"];
	readonly "readonly"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "placeholder"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "autocomplete"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "debounce"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "fitInputWidth"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "suffixIcon"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["suffixIcon"];
	readonly "inputStyle"?: import("vue").StyleValue;
	readonly "inputmode"?: "text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal" | undefined;
	readonly "modelModifiers"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["modelModifiers"];
	readonly "maxlength"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "minlength"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "autosize"?: (AsamRemoteAutocompleteProps<V, I>)["autosize"];
	readonly "parser"?: ((value: string) => string) | undefined;
	readonly "showPassword"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "showWordLimit"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "wordLimitPosition"?: "outside" | "inside" | undefined;
	readonly "containerRole"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "countGraphemes"?: ((value: string) => number) | undefined;
	readonly "triggerOnFocus"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "selectWhenUnmatched"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "hideLoading"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "highlightFirstItem"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "loopNavigation"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "maxSuggestions"?: number | undefined;
};

};
